ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Dominance of high-intensity pixels (white) across the majority of the fluke surface area, with localized low-intensity pixels (black/dark gray) appearing at the distal margin of the right lobe.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Broad contiguous high-intensity region; distinct low-intensity geometric blobs concentrated on the outer distal edge of the right lobe; sparse low-intensity focal spots located near the medial notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped central depression with a wide pixel angle and minimal vertical depth relative to the horizontal span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular low-amplitude serrations extracted as a jagged pixel boundary along the trailing edge, particularly distinct on the right lobe against the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex mathematical curve fitted to the trailing edges of both lobes, transitioning from the notch to the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small, circular low-intensity pixel clusters observed near the central axis and a dense concentration of similar clusters at the distal right lobe boundary.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized accumulation of dark pigmentation or scarring on the distal tip of the right lobe and minor spotting near the notch.
